Overall quality score: 5/10.

The code is readable and fairly well scoped, with decent unit-test intent around vector math and hooks. I would not approve it as-is. The main blockers are that the documented demo path is not runnable from the checked-in repo, story generation cannot bootstrap because it expects a manifest that is not present, and several numerical/operational paths lack validation or failure handling.

Verification: `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/emovec-pycache python -m compileall -q emovec tests` passed. `python -m pytest -q` could not collect because this environment does not have required dependencies installed (`numpy`, `PyYAML`, etc.).

issues.description: generate-stories requires an existing manifest.json, so an empty data/stories directory cannot bootstrap story generation.
Default extraction assumes checked-in story files exist, but data/stories is empty so make demo/all --tiny fails immediately.
Integration test has no precondition skip for missing story data, Hugging Face auth, or model access, making test-all unsuitable for clean CI.
Remote story-generation requests have no timeout, retry, or useful HTTP error handling and can hang indefinitely.
Emotion-derived output paths are not validated, allowing path traversal if config-controlled emotion names contain separators.
Story loader ignores manifest.json and does not validate corpus consistency against configured emotions/topics/story counts.
PCA code divides by total variance without handling zero or near-zero variance inputs, producing NaNs.
Neutral activation capture materializes every token at every layer in memory, which can crash on larger custom neutral corpora.
logit_lens hard-codes Gemma RMSNorm scale behavior while model_name is configurable, producing wrong readings for other architectures.
n_steered_emotions is not validated or deduplicated, so oversized values can duplicate selections and overwrite shift results.
Config loading has no schema/range validation for fractions, layer ranges, counts, dtype, or device values.
span_mean_activations silently returns zero vectors when spans match no tokens, hiding tokenizer-offset or prompt-template bugs.
Model loading does not pin a Hugging Face revision, so runs are not reproducible if the remote model changes.
Generated egg-info is committed and can drift from pyproject.toml/source files.
requirements.txt duplicates project metadata and includes pytest as a runtime dependency rather than dev-only.
logit_lens test only checks shape/order and would not catch the architecture-specific normalization bug.
